name: Subset Teaching Dimension / VC Dimension (Incomparable)
details: Neither parameter admits a universal upper bound in terms of the other, even up to an affine-linear factor.
parameter_1_larger_witness: For every $u\ge3$, $\mathcal C^u_{1/2}=\{\{x_i\}:i\in[u+1]\}\cup\{\{x_i,x_j\}:i,j\in[u+1]\}$ has $\mathrm{STD}=u$ and $\mathrm{VC}=2$: pairs are shattered, while a triple cannot be because every concept has size at most two.
parameter_2_larger_witness: The private-coordinate cubes #classes/private_coordinate_cube have STD one and VC dimension n for every n>=1, by database-owned values 1174 and 1139. Thus VC is unbounded with STD fixed.
proof: Theorem 18(2) gives $\mathrm{STD}(\mathcal C^u_{1/2})=u$, and the displayed size-two construction gives its VC dimension. In the reverse direction, the private-coordinate-cube value proofs give STD one and VC n. The previously cited monomial family from Theorem 19 also remains a valid alternative, but the displayed witness now uses an explicit catalogue family with database-owned endpoint proofs.
